corrections.detail: The successful first compilation emitted no output; an empty pipeline did not create compiler.log, so the unchanged evidence-reference helper rejected the missing file. Preserved the initial failed summary and made the harness create an explicit log even for empty successful output before rerunning.

Initial inventory command imported Verification.psm1 without Evidence.psm1, so Write-VerificationJson was unavailable. Replay exited 1 before copying inputs or executing tests because the inventory file was missing. Preserved its log/summary, imported both modules and made subsequent command errors terminate preparation.
